त्यज् {c1c} P. (त्यजति, तत्याज,
अत्याक्षीत्, त्यक्ष्यति, त्यक्त)
1 To leave (in all
senses), abandon, quit, go away
from; वर्त्म भानोस्त्यजाशु

.
--4
To shun, avoid.
--5 To get rid of,
free oneself from;

.
--6 To
set aside, disregard; त इमेऽवस्थिता
युद्धे प्राणांस्त्यक्त्वा धनानि च

.
--7 To except.
--8 To distribute,
give away; कृतं (संचयं) आश्वयुजे
[]
त्यजेत्

To cause to give
up &c., to deprive (a person) of
anything.
--2 To expel, turn out.
--3 To quit. --Desid. (तित्यक्षति) To
wish to leave &c.

त्यक्त p. p. [त्यज् कर्मणि-क्त]
1
Abandoned, forsaken, left, quitted.
--2 Resigned, surrendered.
--3
Shunned, avoided; see त्यज्.
--Comp.
--अग्निः a Brāhmaṇa who has given
up household fire.
--जीवित, --प्राण
a. ready to abandon life, willing to
run any risk; मदर्थे त्यक्तजीविताः

Abandonment.
--2 Difficulty.
--3 Anger.
--4
Estrangement, dislike, envy.
--5 A
weapon causing abandonment. --m.
--f. --n. Ved. Offspring, descendants.

त्यागः [त्यज्-भावे घञ्]
1 Leaving,
forsaking, abandoning, deserting,
separation; न माता न पिता न स्त्री न
पुत्रस्त्यागमर्हति

.
--3 Gift,
donation, giving away as charity;
करे श्लाघ्यस्त्यागः

.
--5 Secretion, excretion.
--6
Dismissing, discharging.
--7
Sacrificing oneself.
--8 A sage.
--Comp.
--पत्रं a bill of divorcement.
--युत,
--शील a. liberal, generous,
munificent.

त्यागिन् a.
1 Leaving,
abandoning, giving up &c.
--2 Giving away,
a donor.
--3 Heroic, brave.
--4 Liberal.
--5 Sacrificing.
--6 One who does not
look to any reward or result from
the performance of ceremonial rites;
यस्तु कर्मफलत्यागी स त्यागीत्यभिधीयते

त्याजित p. p.
1 Made to leave or
abandon.
--2 Caused to be
disregarded.

त्याज्य a.
1 To be left, shunned or
expelled.
--2 To be given up or
relinquished.
--3 To be sacrificed.
--4
To be excluded.
--ज्यं A part of an
asterism or its duration considered
to be unlucky.
